# Static AI Block

> Free copy-paste AI blocks for any static website. Each block is plain HTML and JavaScript that calls OneTag AI (https://onetagai.com/llms.txt) from the browser: one script tag, no backend. Paste a block into a page and replace YOUR_ONETAG_KEY with a free key (POST {"email"} to https://onetagai.com/api/signup; the key arrives by email).

## Blocks

- [Ask this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/ask-this-page.html): A question box that answers from the page's own content, with follow-ups.
- [Explain selection](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/explain-selection.html): Select any text on the page and an "Explain" button appears next to it.
- [Summarize this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/summarize-page.html): Three buttons, three lengths, the answer streams in.
- [Translate this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/translate-page.html): Pick a language and the main content is rewritten in it; click again to restore.
- [FAQ bot](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/faq-bot.html): Answers only from the FAQ you wrote; says "I don't know" for anything else.
- [Draft a reply](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/draft-reply.html): Paste an email, review or ticket, pick a tone, get a reply you can edit.
- [Rewrite](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/rewrite.html): Make any text shorter, longer, formal or friendly, in place.
- [Extract to JSON](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/extract-json.html): Paste messy text, get structured fields back as an object.
- [Smart search](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/smart-search.html): Describe what you want in plain words and the matching items light up.
- [Describe an image](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/describe-image.html): Alt text for any photo, from a file or any <img> on the page.
- [Explain code](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/code-explain.html): An Explain button on every code block on the page.
- [Quiz from this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/quiz.html): Three multiple-choice questions generated from the page content.
